title: Hypersprint: All-Staff Prep & Runbook (Q3 bridge)
content:
Context:
This is a working runbook for the Hypersprint week and the company-wide All-Staff sync for the Q3 bridge. Purpose is twofold: 1) align exec messaging and high-level OKR changes that need to be announced, and 2) provide an operational checklist so teams can prepare demos, rollouts, and support coverage during the week.

High-level goals for the week (what success looks like):
- Clear, actionable executive updates that reduce follow-up clarifying threads by >50%.
- OKR signal: publish one concise change-set + rationale for platform and product OKRs that product teams can iterate on in the following 2 weeks.
- 95th-percentile run-of-show timing hit for the live session (prep rehearsals done).
- Post-All-Staff comms bundle (recording, slides, short FAQ, dependent tickets) published within 48 hours.

Run-of-Show (working timeline) — All times PT:
- 08:30 — Producer check (AV, captions, recording, Slack channel pinned)
- 09:00 — Exec warm-up (founders + CRO + Head of Product) — 20m
- 09:20 — Company narrative + headline metrics (CEO) — 10m
- 09:30 — New OKR announcements & reasoning (Head of Strategy) — 15m
- 09:45 — Product spotlights (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private) — 20m (3 x 6m + 2m buffer)
- 10:05 — Infrastructure & SRE commitments (SLO updates, Private deployment roadmap) — 10m
- 10:15 — Developer experience demo & quick wins (DX) — 8m
- 10:23 — Customer stories + CS highlight (2 customers, prerecorded clips) — 7m
- 10:30 — Live Q&A (moderated, submit questions in Slack) — 20m
- 10:50 — Close + immediate asks (what to do next, submit follow-ups) — 5m
- 10:55 — Post-session office hours and team standups scheduling (by org)

Prepping the OKR draft that will be announced
- Proposed top-level wording (short):
  - Platform availability: "Improve platform latency and cost efficiency for production workloads by optimizing serving runtime, achieving a 15% reduction in per-token compute cost on typical SAAS workloads by EOY Q4."
  - Developer adoption: "Increase average active API integrations by 30% across PLG cohorts by expanding quickstart templates and reducing time-to-first-call."
  - Enterprise readiness: "Ship Private deployment audit/log retention features and get two pilot enterprise customers in production by EOY Q4."

- Notes on tradeoffs and talking points for execs:
  - Be explicit about measurement: baseline is current Q2 averages (latency p95, cost/token), and we will publish the evaluation harness on Confluence after the All-Staff.
  - Emphasize staged risk: some latency wins come from quantization and batching changes — mention fallback policies to avoid regressions.
  - Frame Dedicated & Private as continuity investments for mid-market/enterprise conversion.

Communications: pre, during, post
- Pre (T-7 days to T-1 day): internal deck draft shared, short 3-line announcement to #all-staff, recording of rehearsal for execs.
- During: pin a Slack thread in #allhands-ops, live transcriptions, and a dedicated Notion/Confluence page with timestamps.
- Post (T+48 hours): single OnePager summarizing changes, recording, slides, and a triage list of follow-up tickets assigned to org leads.

Task matrix (owners + immediate action items)
- Exec narrative + CEO slides: Leah Navarro (owner) — due T-3 days, rehearsal T-1 day.
- OKR wording + measurement plan: Priya Menon (owner) — due T-4 days, link baseline spreadsheet in Confluence.
- Product spotlights (slides + short demo scripts): Diego Alvarez & Maya Chen — each demo 6 minutes, pre-record fallback.
- AV & streaming: Evan Brooks — confirm recording, closed captions, and backup Zoom room.
- Moderation & Qs triage: CS lead (TBD) — collect questions in #allhands-questions; top 10 preselected.
- Post-session communications: comms lead (TBD) + Leah Navarro — deliver within 48 hours.

Demos and operational readiness checklist
- Demo rehearsals: each demo owner to record a 6-minute dry run and upload to linked_artifacts by T-2 days.
- Feature flags: if demos use feature flags, ensure they are toggled for internal accounts only and request infra whitelist for demo accounts.
- Canary/backstop plan: for any announced production changes, attach a rollback/playbook link (see JIRA-OPS-842).

Risk register and mitigations (brief):
- Risk: Exec messaging creates expectation of immediate GA for features.
  - Mitigation: use explicit language "pilot" or "beta" and list customers in pilot program.
- Risk: Demo fails live (network/credentials).
  - Mitigation: prerecord fallback + engineer on standby in the Zoom backchannel.
- Risk: OKR wording generates heavy org-level pushback on scope or measurement.
  - Mitigation: include a clear 2-week comment window and a sync with product leaders post-All-Staff.

Q&A guidance for moderators
- Accept questions in Slack channel and upvote. Preselect top 10 by upvotes.
- Reserve time for 3 live audience questions (from broad tactical to product strategy).
- If the question is deep technical (model/hardware), route to infra/product SRE office hours.

Deliverables checklist (pre and post)
- Pre (owner/due):
  - Draft slides (Leah) — T-3d
  - OKR one-paragraph rationale (Priya) — T-4d
  - Demo recordings (Diego/Maya) — T-2d
  - Rehearsal full run-through recorded (Leah + execs) — T-1d
  - Slack channels created and pinned resources (Evan) — T-1d
- Post (owner/due):
  - Publish recording + slides (Comms) — T+48h
  - Issue follow-up tickets (owners assigned) — T+72h
  - Run OKR feedback sync (product & eng leads) — T+7d

Open questions / things to decide
- Who will be the named comms lead for the 48-hour post bundle? (TBD)
- Final decision on which OKR metric thresholds are "stretch" vs "commit" (need input from Eng and Product).
- Do we include an external customer mention in the All-Staff? (Legal/Customer-ops checkbox)

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep slides terse — 3 slides for OKR rationale, 2 per demo with one-sentence TL;DR.
- Execs: give an "ask" at the end (what to do next this week). Helps channel immediate action.
- Save a short bullet list for engineering on how rollout will be observed (tracing, cost dashboards).

Appendix: quick references
- Baseline metrics spreadsheet: https://confluence.redwood.com/spaces/PLATFORM/pages/baseline-metrics-q2
- Rehearsal Zoom link (internal): zoom://rehearsal-hypersprint (producer will update)
- JIRA triage epic: JIRA-OPS-842
- Recording + edit owner: Evan Brooks

Version notes: v0-1 initial working doc for ops + exec prep (Leah). Will iterate after Priya's OKR measurement draft and Diego's demo dry-run.
